p.s: In my opnion, there is no doubt that it is better to have broad knowledge of many academic subject than to specialize in one specific subject.
However, some people have opposite opinion, so I must explain carefully.
we have those who believe that people had better to study about one specific subject.
they think that the way is more effective to produce professionals.
In addition, they feel that the wide range of knowledge is not necessary for professionals such as engineers and artist.
forexample, some pianist who had educated only play the piano.
However, he became a very famous pianist.
even though he did not have general knowledge, he could live himself.
Over the recent years, the problem has happened which the young people can not find their way.
some person feel that The wide range of knwoledge affcted the problem.
It is natural that people who has a lot of way make him confused.
In contrast, we have those who believe that the people, especially students must study many accademic subject.
because, studying only one subject make narrow student life.
we must pay attention what student to need.
after that, we must give them chance todecide.
